teaching_workflow.student: Teacher agenda link -> private/shared Google Drive lesson PDF -> Send a Copy -> Notability on iPad; hyperlinks from PDF to public original web interactives.

teaching_workflow.schedule: Publisher lesson days and 25 full-period section readings count as core. Monday Modeling Monday / optional short (42 min) experiments, Monday pretest review, formal tests, extensions and buffer are separate and NOT part of 107.
teaching_workflow.known_calendar: Senior cutoff May 7, 2027 and remaining students June 9, 2027. Approved full 107 core periods despite cutoff; do not silently trim.
